testSuite: User Management CRUD E2E Tests (MOC-151 Phase 3)
notes: Tests created and syntax-validated. Execution requires Docker services (postgres, server on :3000, admin-portal on :3001). Run with: cd testing/user-e2e && npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts

testCases.name: Page loads and displays user list
testCases.expected: h1 contains 'User Management', search bar visible

testCases.name: Create user modal opens with empty form
testCases.expected: Dialog visible with Create User title, name field empty

testCases.name: Create user with valid data via API
testCases.expected: 201 + user data returned, email visible in list

testCases.name: Form validation - empty name shows error
Form validation - empty email shows error
Form validation - short password
testCases.expected: 'Password must be at least 6 characters' validation error visible

testCases.name: Edit user modal pre-fills with current data via UI
testCases.expected: Edit button opens dialog, name field pre-filled

testCases.name: Update user active status via API
Delete user via UI confirmation dialog
testCases.expected: Delete confirmation dialog, user removed from list

testCases.name: API - GET /api/users/:id returns 404 for unknown user
Create user with all optional fields via API
testCases.expected: 201 + full user data including name, email, role, portalAccess
